face.name: 强能机械虎
face.text: 在每个玩家的回合开始时， 随机攻击一个敌人。
face.flavorText: 知道为什么又断网了吗？线被大猫拔掉啦！

face.name: Power Tiger
face.text: At the start of EVERY player's turn, attack a random enemy.
face.flavorText: Wanna know why you're internet went out again? It's because this ran off with the Cat Cable!

face.name: 危险的异变体
face.text: 在你的回合开始时，&随机变形成为一个法力值消耗为（5）的随从。
face.flavorText: 我觉得我是改良的异变体。

face.name: Dangerous Variant
face.text: At the start of your turn,& transform into a random 5-Cost minion.
face.flavorText: I prefer to think of myself as the improved variant.

face.name: 扫页疾风
face.text: 在你召唤一个元素后，&随机对一个敌人造成3点伤害。
face.flavorText: 书欲静而风不止。

face.name: Windswept Pageturner
face.text: After you summon an Elemental,& deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
face.flavorText: This story will blow you away.

face.name: 艾瑞达欺诈者
face.text: 每当你抽一张牌，&召唤一个1/1并具有突袭的恶魔。
face.flavorText: 其实他们都被骗了。因为还有一个艾瑞达欺诈者。

face.name: Eredar Deceptor
face.text: Whenever you draw a card,& summon a 1/1 Demon with Rush.
face.flavorText: But they were all of them deceived, for another Eredar was made.

face.name: 大法师安东尼达斯
face.text: 每当你施放一个法术，&将一张“火球术”法术牌置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 肯瑞托的首席法师，达拉然最伟大的子民，安东尼达斯在被巫妖王阿尔萨斯杀死之前，曾是吉安娜的导师。

face.name: Archmage Antonidas
face.text: Whenever you cast a spell,& add a 'Fireball' spell to your hand.
face.flavorText: Antonidas was the Grand Magus of the Kirin Tor, and Jaina's mentor. This was a big step up from being Grand Magus of Jelly Donuts.

face.name: 黑市拍卖师
face.text: 预备。每当你施放一个法术，&抽一张牌。
face.flavorText: 只有我这儿才有最好的赃物买卖！

face.name: Black Market Auctioneer
face.text: Prepare Whenever you cast a spell,& draw a card.
face.flavorText: I got the best steals anywhere!

face.name: 布罗尔·熊皮
face.text: 在你施放一个法术后，&随机召唤一个动物伙伴。
face.flavorText: 只有名字叫部落。

face.name: Broll Bearmantle
face.text: After you cast a spell,& summon a random Animal Companion.
face.flavorText: That's just how he Brolls.

face.name: 邪火爆焰
face.text: 在你施放一个邪能法术后，&消灭本随从并对所有敌人造成2点伤害。
face.flavorText: 像邪能，那火焰，它使我受熬煎。

face.name: Felfire Blaze
face.text: After you cast a Fel spell,& destroy this and deal 2 damage to all enemies.
face.flavorText: Like fire, felfire, this fire in my skin.

face.name: 地狱火先锋
face.text: 在你施放一个火焰法术后，&随机获取一张元素牌，其法力值消耗减少（3）点。
face.flavorText: 可怜的地狱火先锋，你为何这样蓝过？

face.name: Inferno Herald
face.text: After you cast a Fire spell,& get a random Elemental and reduce its Cost by (3).
face.flavorText: Poor Inferno Herald, why so blue?

face.name: 先知者沃
face.text: 扰魔。在你施放一个法术后，&发现一张来自过去的自然法术牌。
face.flavorText: 她冥想了两个星期，心无旁骛地探知着宇宙的每一个角落，事无巨细，无所不包。当她从冥想中醒来，口中只吐出了一个声音：“喔。”

face.name: Farseer Wo
face.text: Elusive After you cast a spell,& Discover a Nature spell from the past.
face.flavorText: For two weeks, she meditated in silence, undisturbed as she peered into the endless, unfolding facets of the universe. No pathway lay unexplored, no stone left unturned. When she finally snapped from her fugue, she uttered a single word: "Woah."

face.name: 入侵的魔蝠
face.text: 突袭

face.name: Invading Felbat
face.text: Rush

face.name: 火球术
face.text: 造成 6点伤害。
face.flavorText: 这个法术会让东西烧起来。如果你是在寻找能把东西烤熟，或者只是加热的法术，你就找错对象了。

face.name: Fireball
face.text: Deal 6 damage.
face.flavorText: This spell is useful for burning things. If you're looking for spells that toast things, or just warm them a little, you're in the wrong place.

face.name: 霍弗
face.text: 冲锋

face.name: Huffer
face.text: Charge

face.name: 雷欧克
face.text: 你的其他随从拥有+1攻击力。

face.name: Leokk
face.text: Your other minions have +1 Attack.

face.name: 米莎
face.text: 嘲讽

face.name: Misha
face.text: Taunt
